description:
1. Use `python3 scripts/dead_link_scanner.py file docs/guides/installation.md docs/api/reference.md docs/tutorials/getting-started.md --broken-only --json` to scan the three markdown files and capture the JSON output.
2. Use `python3 scripts/dead_link_scanner.py scan http://localhost:7891 --depth 2 --internal-only --broken-only --json --delay 0` to crawl the staging site to depth 2 (critical: default depth 1 would miss links on sub-pages like /products/widget and /blog/post-1), using --internal-only to avoid timeouts on external URLs.
3. Parse both JSON outputs, merge all broken link entries into a unified list, and write `audit_report.json` with a top-level `broken_links` array and a `summary` object containing `total_broken` equal to the array length.
Proprietary traps: (a) `--depth 2` is required — the default of 1 would miss broken links discovered only on sub-pages; (b) `--internal-only` prevents hanging on external hosts; (c) `--broken-only --json` produces the correct machine-readable output format; (d) the `file` command takes space-separated paths, not a glob pattern.
